label: b27: hist8 (move history 8), seed 21 of 24, 100M
notes: Batch b27: move history in the observation (SNEK_OBS_HISTORY, plans/obs-history.md: two bits per past move read off the body, most recent first), one knob at three depths (0, 4, 8) x 8 seeds, 8 seeds per depth so every wave of 8 is one observation width (the shared stage-A eval workers are one process per slot and cannot serve two widths -- tools/scheduler.py wave_obs_history). Base: b24's config (horizon anneal to 50% of the cap: lambda 0.95->0.999, gamma 0.99->0.999, entropy 0.01->0.001; lr 2.5e-4, epochs 4, mb 512, T 256, clip 0.2, huber, adv norm, grad 0.5, adam eps 1e-7, vf 0.5, target_kl 0, b2 reward = chase-safe 0.1 gate 75, fc 320, 128 lanes) plus SNEK_STEP_PENALTY 0.01, at 100M, seeds pinned to the arm letter. The 26-value observation era (obs26-20260907); hist4/hist8 arms carry the depth in their obs_era (-hist4 / -hist8) and their sidecar, so shards adopt it (tools/sidecar_env.py). Phase 1 of the plan (docs/findings.md 2026-09-07) predicts no effect: the best checkpoints fail by starving in a loop of period length+1, which four or eight moves of history cannot break. The user wants the measurement anyway. Judged on perfect rate against the hist0 cell; b26 pen01 (50M, 4 seeds) is a loose reference for the base.
